Senior Python Backend Engineer




We are seeking an experienced Senior Python Backend Developer to architect and develop backend systems for a cloud-based engineering platform that hosts and runs professional electrical engineering and grid modeling software (MATLAB, PSCAD, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, ETAP, PSSE, OpenDSS, etc.)

This platform enables engineers to run simulations, manage scenarios, visualize results, and unify multiple grid analysis tools through a single web interface.** The developer will be responsible for designing robust backend APIs, orchestrating simulation engines, managing workflows, handling large data stores, and ensuring high scalability using AWS cloud services and MongoDB.** This role requires strong backend engineering skills plus an understanding of scientific computing or engineering workflows.** You will work closely with power system engineers, product owners, and software architects to deliver a robust digital platform that improves engineering productivity, harmonizes workflows, and enables advanced decision making.** Bachelor's Degree or equivalent relevant experience.** 8-10 years of related work experience in Web Development including Python, MongoDB, S3 AWS.** Understanding of electrical power systems, grid integration, Solar/Wind/BESS** Good communication skills.** Ability to implement, build, maintain Web applications.** Good hold on design patterns, development frameworks, coding standards, Industry practices** Experience in Unit test automationPython, MongoDB, S3 AWS, MATLAB/PSCAD/PowerFactory/etcknowledge of electrical engineering tools (Matlab, PSCAD, DigSilent, ETAP, PSSE etc)8-10 years** Design and build scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI / Flask / Django) for scalable cloud-hosted web application for accessing and running electrical engineering tools (Matlab, PSCAD, DigSilent, ETAP, PSSE etc).** Develop REST/GraphQL APIs for Model upload/download, Grid networks, templates, and metadata, Authentication and permissions** Build microservices for modular tool integration (MATLAB/PSCAD/PowerFactory/etc.).** Work with your Team to organize and manage work, including thoughtful participation during refinement sessions.** Balance your skillset, interest, and the needs of the product to define, build, test, deliver, and maintain as necessary.** Along with all Team Members, be both responsible and accountable for the product's requirements/design definition, build, test, delivery, and continual maintenance.** Assit PM in showcasing the most critical components of the developed product to relevant Stakeholders.** Work effectively with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, Release Engineer, Product Manager, and all applicable Stakeholders relating to tools, process, techniques, and relationships.** Comprehend blocking items that prevent planned work from being completed, then navigate to help eliminate the barriers.Python, MongoDB, S3 AWS
